description: Three heatmaps of 1–5 scores for eight models on eight metrics (ACC, CPL, ORG, CPH, SCI, CNS, FFH, FFB) for Class I, II and III cases, plus a radar chart of an ablation study of ZODIAC.
uncertain: No numeric values are printed in the heatmaps; all cell values are colour-based estimates and may be off by about 0.3.
Radar values are approximate visual estimates.
